title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, providing users with a powerful and intuitive new way to explore and discover critical information.

title: Advanced File Control in Your Editor
summary: Now, effortlessly manage, upload, download, and remove your files, plus customize their appearance directly within the editor for a more powerful content creation experience.

title: Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Now you can explore our public roadmap to discover recently shipped features, what's coming next, and our exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've updated our checkboxes to be more intuitive and visually appealing, allowing for easier clicking and smooth drag-and-drop functionality.

title: Seamless Team Editing
summary: Collaborate effortlessly with new, clearer indicators that make real-time teamwork smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Effortless Collaboration & Discovery
summary: Now you can effortlessly find and collaborate on all relevant shared items from your network, thanks to significantly improved search and visibility.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: We are thrilled to bring Noeko closer to you by introducing comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, empowering global users everywhere.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unparalleled control and transparent collaboration in its ongoing development.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Map Exploration
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base by easily filtering your Constellation view with tags, time windows, and shared items to discover new connections and streamline your workflow.

title: Precision Search and Curated Collections
summary: Navigate your knowledge base with unprecedented precision by applying advanced filters and saving your custom searches as personalized collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Note Previews & Layouts
summary: Unlock a more intuitive way to organize and explore your thoughts with dynamic new layouts that seamlessly display linked content previews and interactive options.

title: Noeko: Your Infrastructure, Your Way
summary: Prepare for the official launch of Noeko, bringing the freedom of self-hosting and the power of premium plans to tailor your experience precisely to your needs.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with New Themes
summary: Prepare for a visual refresh as we meticulously refine current themes and unveil exciting new options to make your workspace truly yours.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Our improved greetings will now precisely match the time of day, ensuring a warm and accurate welcome every time you visit.

title: Efficiently Organize Your Tagged Content
summary: Efficiently manage your tagged content with new direct actions that allow you to quickly remove or organize items directly from any tag list.

title: Broaden Your Knowledge Base with New Source Types
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider array of content, including videos, websites, and text, to deeply enrich your knowledge base and workflow.
